name: 182. Opaque provider cost stays out of the input split in logs (opaque-provider-cost)
description: Gateway regression for PR #8055. OpenRouter's /v1/decisions response carries its billed cost as an opaque usage.cost with only total_cost set. The logging plugin stores that total in the cost column, and the log row's cost_breakdown used to attribute the whole total to input_cost, so the log detail view showed the provider's total as an input cost. The case runs a decision through openrouter, then polls GET /api/logs/{x-request-id} and asserts cost_breakdown.total_cost equals the response's usage.cost.total_cost while input_cost and output_cost stay empty (pre-fix: input_cost equals the total).

item.name: Log cost_breakdown keeps an opaque provider total out of input_cost - openrouter/typesafe/jev-1.13
